title: Red Hat Security Advisory: OpenShift Container Platform 4.15.71 packages and security update
description: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.15.71 includes multiple security fixes addressing vulnerabilities such as arbitrary code execution via cross-site scripting, denial of service via malformed HTTP/2 frames, privilege escalation through incorrect Punycode processing, insecure remote script execution during installation, man-in-the-middle attacks via untrusted certificates, and memory handling issues. Users of OpenShift Container Platform 4.15 are advised to upgrade to these updated packages and images to mitigate these critical and important security issues.
